name: Companies House API
owner: Companies House (Department for Business and Trade)
gives: limited company records: name, number, status, registered office (not people)

why.quote: The Companies House API lets you retrieve information about limited companies (and other companies that fall within the Companies Act 2006). The data returned is live and real-time, and is simple to use and understand.
